question.text: Identify the pair of physical quantities which have different dimensions:

options.text: Specific heat capacity and Latent heat

solution.text: The SI unit of specific heat is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi>kg</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> and the SI unit of latent heat is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi>kg</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. We can see that the quantities in option <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>D</mi></math> have different dimensions.
